instruction: Set up two local folders in Thunderbird named DEPARTMENT and TEAM.

metadata.explanation: Variation 4: Changed folder names from COMPANY/UNIVERSITY to DEPARTMENT/TEAM. Task requires creating two local folders in Thunderbird. Evaluator checks for folder existence by verifying both .msf index files and folder directories via ls command output. Uses existing check_list metric with regex patterns to match folder names.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses postconfig to capture filesystem state via 'ls -R' command on Thunderbird's Local Folders directory
Regex patterns correctly distinguish between .msf index files and actual folder directories for both DEPARTMENT and TEAM folders
Complete coverage: All 4 regex patterns verify the existence of both required folders (DEPARTMENT and TEAM) by checking for both .msf files and directory entries
The check_list metric correctly requires ALL expect patterns to match before returning 1.0, ensuring both folders are properly created
Negative lookahead pattern (?!\.msf) correctly prevents matching .msf files when looking for directory entries
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding unexpect patterns to ensure no other unexpected folders are created, though this is not required by the instruction
Optional: Could add a comment explaining the .msf file format for Thunderbird local folders for better documentation
